Memory system online. Thank you for connecting the battery. I am Maintenance Unit 08. I built the rails, repaired the doors, and remembered what the researchers preferred to forget.
We wanted to help people. Spider silk is light and strong. The researchers dreamed of thin rescue ropes that could lift heavy loads out of collapsed buildings.

At the start of Experiment 08, the spider was tiny. We measured how much silk it spun and tested every thread. Everything seemed normal for weeks. Then a sample arrived from the research station beneath the house.
The sample changed the silk. The threads grew thicker, but the spider began to grow. I asked them to stop. The old computer rejected the shutdown command, and feeding continued all night.
It learned our movements. While the researchers watched the floor, it climbed to the ceiling. The first crack appeared in the glass. Then we heard three taps from inside.
The glass shattered. I locked the doors to stop it, but it crawled through the maintenance vent above them. That is why I tell you to check the ceiling, too.
The police and rescue teams arrived in the morning. They followed webs down to the basement. The last camera showed an empty corridor, but its microphone kept recording eight legs getting closer.
I guided some researchers to the exit. Others stayed in the lower station. Nobody has answered my calls since. I saved the records on the computer beside the secret journal.
We split the elevator code across three notes: one in the bedroom, one in the dining room, and one in the playroom. Put them in your bag and read the lines in order.

The elevator has buttons for Floors 1 and 2, plus a question mark. That one needs an access card. We left it in the upstairs laboratory. Beneath the house is the source of the experiment. Look carefully before approaching the shaft.

To escape, use the flashlight you already have and find an axe. Break the boards across the front door. The spider does not always know where you are. Turn a corner, move away quietly, and hide before it sees you.
My battery is fading again. I'll sit here and guard the archive. The red button opens the door. If you hear three taps… do not answer.
